texts.text:
The clearing has not moved since the rite ended. The spiralgrass still holds the warmth of every offering pressed into it.

Seren remains kneeling where the wish left her, composed, her whole face turned toward the Dohkar.

The presiding Dohkar lifts one hand without looking at me, the gesture of a man finishing a task he never wanted.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: She will answer for her conduct in preliminary review.

Two figures step from the assembly at his word. They do not hesitate.

Julian moves before they reach me. His hand finds the edge of The Answer again, anchoring it between us.

JULIAN: This matter concerns me as well.

The assembly shifts. No one speaks the accusation aloud, yet every eye measures the space between my hand and his.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: Bring her.

The witnesses reach for me. I feel the choice rise in my throat before the words can form.

I realize that old tarot deck is still in my hand. Reassuringly solid. Present. One of the heavy gold cards slips out — “Petition Fate” is inscribed in it.

quoted: She will answer for her conduct in preliminary review.
This matter concerns me as well.
summary: The player chose to run in shame in the prior scene, which replaced the scheduled review with pursuit after the fact.
The Dohkar's order makes the review concrete and irreversible; witnesses now approach.
The presiding Dohkar made clear the rite and ruling are his to decide.

oas.pcSay: I shaped nothing. Ask me properly.
oas.pcSayRaw: I shaped nothing. Ask me properly.
oas.liDialogue: You shaped every glance toward me like roots seeking the same vein. Did you call for rescue hoping I would answer?
oas.liAction: Julian’s gaze held mine, the double blade still warm in my palm.

oas.pcSay: I will decide how this unfolds from here.
oas.pcDo: I close my fingers tighter around The Answer, claiming the weight of it as my own.
oas.pcSayRaw: I will decide how this unfolds from here.
oas.pcDoRaw: Grip the Answer firmly, asserting control
oas.liDialogue: You shape the air as if the roots must answer only to you. Did you call for rescue, or did you call for the one who holds the blade?
oas.liAction: Julian’s gaze holds mine, the double blade still warm in my palm.

oas.pcSay: A soft breath slips free before I can catch it.
oas.pcDo: I stand perfectly still, breath held tight in my chest.
oas.pcSayRaw: *A soft exhale escapes, betraying my tension.*
oas.liDialogue: Your quiet only intensifies what your fingers unveiled when desire spiraled. Did you craft it so that I would be the one to seek your truth?
oas.liAction: His shoulders tensed as he observes me remain motionless.

oas.pcSay: I will not speak until the cost is named.
oas.pcDo: I draw my hand back, the double blade held at distance.
oas.pcSayRaw: I won’t answer until I know what’s at stake.
oas.pcDoRaw: Pull my hand back, holding the Answer away
oas.liDialogue: You twisted desire with the curve of your lips when you turned your attention to me. Did you craft it so the Provast would be compelled to take you in front of everyone?
oas.liAction: Julian's fingers wrap around my hand on the weapon, halting the pull back.

oas.pcSay: Let us see if I can surprise you.
oas.pcDo: I press the Answer deeper into my palm.
oas.pcSayRaw: Let’s see if I can surprise you.
oas.pcDoRaw: Press the Answer deeper into my palm
oas.liDialogue: You sculpted desire with the angle of your focus on me, Lirael. Were you seeking salvation, or for the Provast to unveil what you ignited?
oas.liAction: Julian's hand envelops my wrist on the dagger, anchoring it in place.

oas.pcSay: I care about what you think of me, Julian.
oas.pcDo: I meet his eyes, laying bare the truth I carry.
oas.pcSayRaw: I care about what you think of me, Julian.
oas.pcDoRaw: Look him in the eyes, exposing my truth
oas.liDialogue: Your eyes reveal the craving you ignited in me during the ritual. Did you manipulate the wish so the Provast senses it now?
oas.liAction: Julian's hold sharpens on the weapon as he locks onto my stare.
